semanticDecisions: the gate refuses a search only when exact trigram facts of the whole subject prove absence; the facts are the same M3TQ.Facts the per-matcher precompute produced, now the per-owner cache entry
a flat String subject never pays a facts computation: the stock exact engine runs (the measured 9x..70x regression against stock is removed)
a sub-region (region(from, to) narrower than the text) or a length outside the 256..32768 band runs the exact engine; no partial facts are computed

the per-owner facts are computed on the first use inside the band, as the mixed indexOf paths already do (about 70 ns per unit, M3TQ.scanFacts sorts a long[] of every trigram); a one-shot regex over a fresh owner keeps that cost, which the next leaf measures and cuts (facts built as a set instead of a sort)
SharedSecrets.getJavaLangAccess() may be null before System.initPhase1: the gate then runs the exact engine
the hitEnd/requireEnd observables of a refused search are unchanged from A1 and equal the flat results in the parity test, anchored patterns included
